pricing.q: Can you work with my interior designer?
pricing.a: Yes. Send the drawings or renders on WhatsApp. Our team will review the project with you and your designer.

timeline.q: What should I send to get started?
timeline.a: A plan, a few inspiration photographs or a short description is a useful starting point. If you have drawings, send those too. The team will guide the next steps.

materials.q: How do we choose materials and finishes?
materials.a: Share the look and practical requirements you have in mind. Our team will discuss materials, finishes and hardware that suit the project.

commercial.a: Yes — offices, cafés, and shops, from single pieces to complete turnkey fit-outs.

statement.title: Measured. Drawn. Built. Installed.
statement.text: One workshop in Tbilisi does all of it. We measure your space, draw it in 3D, build every piece ourselves and install it with our own team — so what you approve on screen is exactly what arrives. Most of our clients come with a designer; we build their drawings to the millimetre.
